is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses exclusively on Aedes aegypti (e.g. title: 'Insecticide resistance levels and mechanisms in Aedes aegypti populations in and around Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso').

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study genotyped target-site mutations in Aedes aegypti (V1016I, F1534C, S989P, V1016G) and not any of the listed Anopheles target markers.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No extractable genotype data for any of the target Anopheles insecticide resistance markers.

african_field_population.evidence: Aedes aegypti larvae were collected in 2016 from field breeding sites in 1200 Logements, Tabtenga, and Goundry in and around Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso (Page 4).

is_primary_study.evidence: The paper presents original empirical field sampling, bioassays, target-site mutation genotyping, and qPCR gene expression analyses.

sub_country_location.evidence: Specific localities with GPS coordinates are provided: 1200 Logements (12° 22' 3.569''N, 1° 29' 50.24''W), Tabtenga (12° 21' 58.039''N, 1° 26' 59.074''W), and Goundry (12° 31' 4.262''N, 1° 20' 25.771''W) (Page 4).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected during the rainy season from August to October 2016 (Page 4).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine original collection of Aedes aegypti in Ouagadougou in 2016.

supplement.evidence: Supplementary files S1-S5 are referenced in the main text as providing raw data, but the paper itself is ineligible based on species.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated insecticide susceptibility, kdr mutations (1016I, 1534C), and P450 candidate gene expression in Aedes aegypti populations from urban, semi-urban, and rural sites in and around Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso. It is ineligible for the database because it studies Aedes aegypti rather than Anopheles malaria vectors.
exclusion_reasons: Study investigated Aedes aegypti, not Anopheles mosquitoes.
Does not report genotyping for any of the targeted Anopheles insecticide resistance markers.
